lines.text: Aithough evaluations were conducted with Delhi 76 and
34 varieties of tobacco, the invention i. not restricted to
these specific varieties. Delhi 76 and 34 are among the three
recommended varieties for Ontario since these varieties
together with Virginia 115 are considered superior to other
varieties of flue-cured tobacce in most respects. Studies have
shown that contact type desuckerants are relatively unaffected
by tobacco variety and thus it is contemplated that the
compositions of this invention will inhibit the growth of
axillary buds on other licensed varieties of flue-cured
tobacco.
